title: 第14章 忘恩负义第15章 先斩后奏
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
“院长……”冷幽兰有些不情愿；她来到沉翔面前说道：“兄弟，看来我不能陪你去闯荡世界了，不过，会有机会的！”
沉翔摸着她那美丽柔软的白发，将她抱在怀里，笑道：“嗯，你要全力修炼，提升实力，下次见面，我一定要考验一下你的实力！”
冷幽兰点了点头，就在这时，沉翔将脸凑近了她的脸颊，在她耳边低声说道：“幽兰，如果院长敢对你动粗，你只要说兔子，她就绝对不会的。”敢对你做什么。”
“兔子？”
冷幽兰心中疑惑，但还是点了点头。
柳梦儿是涅盘境武者，显然，她听到了沉翔的话。她娇嫩的身躯因愤怒而微微颤抖；她暗暗咬牙。纤纤是她唯一的弟子，也是沉翔的妻子，况且冷幽兰也可以算作她的弟子。虽然她是沉翔的义妹，但现在仔细一看，她们的关系却并不那么简单。
“这里的事情就交给我吧！我和古东辰也是朋友，这对我来说只是一点点的工作！”
柳梦儿说道。
虽然她和沉翔才认识了很短一段时间，但冷幽兰还是很高兴。虽然还是有些舍不得，但她已经很满足了。她脸上带着甜甜的笑容，跟着柳梦儿离开了。这让柳梦儿有些意外；她知道冷幽兰平时冷漠、彪悍、霸道、狂野，但现在看来，她也像普通女孩一样有情绪。
这一刻，她不禁想起了自己和沉翔一起度过的时光……不也是一样吗？想到和沉翔发生的种种事情，她的脸微微红了，心中复杂的情绪被激起。
柳梦儿带着冷幽兰离开后，沉翔继续留在这里，等待丹渊彻底康复；只有这样，他才能毫无顾虑地离开。过了几天，冰风谷果然派来了人；虽然只有二十人，但这二十人却都是真武境。
矿井安全之后，沉翔便告别了丹渊，返回了太武宗！
沉翔在飞行的同时，也在思考如何应对谭长老勾结陆家和魔道宗的事情；他必须除掉这个危险人物！
六天过去了，沉翔正在桃源省，在云端飞行。因为看不到下面美丽的风景，他感到无比的无聊。正当他想要再飞低一点的时候，一股强大的气气忽然冲天而起，掀开了大片的云彩；这让他感到惊讶。仔细一看，他听到了打斗的声音，没想到下面竟然有人在打斗。
沉翔躲在云层之上，飞向了一个偏僻的地方。他降落在一座高山上，观察着这场战斗，却看到许多黑袍人正在围攻一队白袍人。
“他们不是丹香道源的弟子吗？那些黑袍人难道是魔道武者？”
沉翔不确定的说道。他从那座高山之巅滑落而下，取出了一把剑。
那些黑袍人手持奇异的兵器，真气也十分诡异邪恶。靠近了一些之后，沉翔就确定他们是魔道武者了。他们攻击的不仅仅是丹香桃源的弟子，还有真武宗和兽武宗的弟子。
太武宗与丹香桃源的关系一向很好。他们从来没有发生过任何冲突。显然，沉翔是要去救他们，因为他们现在的处境很不利。他们周围有很多魔道武者，而且那些魔道武者的实力都比他们强。
“居然有两个真武境三重的武者，看来魔道弟子真是绝望了！”

沉翔取出了青龙屠魔刀。如果不使用这把神刀，他根本无法轻易解决这件事。除此之外，他还要警惕那些真武宗和兽武宗的弟子。
当他将青龙真气灌入青龙屠魔刀时，一股令人窒息的气息骤然流淌而出。沉翔挥舞着这柄霸气大刀，冲进了人群之中，一刀劈下，划出一道青色明亮的弧线，发出‘秀秀’的声音。这一击，瞬间斩杀了十名凡武境十级的武者。
沉翔立刻释放出气屏；这就是【玄武罗天罩】。这样一来，他就可以拥有非常坚固的防御，再加上这层无形的气罩，实力不足的人就无法接近他；他们都会感觉自己仿佛受到了强横波浪的冲击。
丹香桃源的弟子们看到有人来帮忙后，立即发现救世主所使用的武器有些熟悉。他们发现这就是他们听说过的沉翔所用的宝器，这才放下心来。沉翔一到，就干净利落地快速斩杀了数十名凡武境十级的武者。
沉翔的杀戮之心开始跳动，吸收了大量的煞气，同时不断释放出强烈的杀戮之气，吓得那些魔道武者心惊肉跳，仿佛遇到了魔神化身。
沉翔的刀势如一道雷霆疯狂舞动，将那些魔道武者杀得惨败，将他们炸得粉碎。转眼间，真武境三重魔道武者就只剩下两名了。
“沉翔，我们化骨族不会放过你的！”
一名独眼男子一边说道，一边对着身旁高瘦青年拍出一掌。手掌带着恐怖的力量落在那瘦弱的身躯上，让那高瘦青年向沉翔飞去。一边发出委屈的惨叫，他的身体化为毒黑水，向沉翔飞溅而去。
沉翔只是侧身一闪，就躲开了。他没想到，魔道武者竟然如此狠毒，牺牲自己的同伴来逃命。
那个独眼男子以为自己可以拖延沉翔一段时间，这样他就能快速逃走。然而，还没等他跑出多远，他忽然就感觉到一股令人窒息的压力从背后吞没了他的身体。
沉翔一边追赶那个独眼男子，一边挥舞着青龙屠魔刀。猛烈的刀锋劈下，爆炸声爆发，那独眼男子被斩成了碎片。
丹香桃源、真武宗、兽武宗的弟子，看到这一幕，都不禁打了个冷颤。就在刚刚，他们还陷入了一场苦战；再这样下去，他们肯定会全军覆没。然而他们没想到，沉翔竟然出现了，他一个人，竟然斩杀了那些化骨一族的弟子。
“这就是太武宗有史以来最年轻、最强的武者的实力吗？价值一千万晶石，沉翔！”
一名丹香桃源弟子惊呼道。
“确实很像啊！虽然看上去很不一样，但是那把大刀和我在通缉海报上看到的一模一样！”
另一个男人说道。
就在丹香桃源的弟子们感激不已的时候，真武宗和兽武宗的弟子们却如蜜蜂般蜂拥而至，手中握着兵器，一脸贪婪之色；他们相信，这么多人，一定能抓住沉翔，到时候，他们就能得到沉翔手中的那把一千万晶石和宝刀。
“忘恩负义的家伙，快阻止他们！”
一名丹香桃源的中年男子喊道。他手持长枪飞了过来，毫不犹豫地将冲向沉翔的真武宗弟子刺死。
看到掌门的娴熟施展之后，丹香桃源的弟子们也是一一涌上来，与真武宗和兽武宗的弟子交战起来。

“丹香桃源师弟、师弟，都到我身后来吧！”
沉翔大喝一声；他脸上的表情彻底凝重而冰冷。刚才他救了真武宗和兽武宗的弟子，他们不但忘恩负义，还敢对他出手！
content_en:
"Dean..." Leng Youlan was a little reluctant; she came to Chen Xiang and said: "Brother, it seems that I can't accompany you to explore the world, but there will be a chance!"
Chen Xiang touched her beautiful and soft white hair, held her in his arms, and said with a smile: "Well, you have to practice hard and improve your strength. Next time we meet, I will definitely test your strength!"
Leng Youlan nodded. At this moment, Chen Xiang brought his face close to her cheek and whispered in her ear: "Youlan, if the dean dares to be rough with you, just say rabbit, and she will never do anything to you." "
"rabbit? "
Leng Youlan was confused, but nodded anyway.
Liu Meng'er is a warrior in the Nirvana realm. Apparently, she heard Chen Xiang's words. Her delicate body trembled slightly with anger; she secretly gritted her teeth. Xianxian is her only disciple and Chen Xiang's wife. Besides, Leng Youlan can also be counted as her disciple. Although she is Chen Xiang's adopted sister, but now taking a closer look, their relationship is not that simple.
"Leave things here to me! Gu Dongchen and I are also friends, so this is just a little bit of work for me! "
Liu Meng'er said.
Although she and Chen Xiang had only known each other for a short period of time, Leng Youlan was still very happy. Although she was still a little reluctant to part with it, she was already very satisfied. With a sweet smile on her face, she followed Liu Menger and left. This surprised Liu Meng'er; she knew that Leng Youlan was usually cold, tough, domineering, and wild, but now it seemed that she had emotions like an ordinary girl.
At this moment, she couldn't help but think of the time she spent with Chen Xiang... Wasn't it the same? Thinking of all the things that happened with Chen Xiang, her face turned slightly red, and the complicated emotions in her heart were aroused.
After Liu Meng'er left with Leng Youlan, Chen Xiang continued to stay here and waited for Dan Yuan to recover completely; only in this way could he leave without any worries. A few days later, Icewind Valley indeed sent people; although there were only twenty people, these twenty people were all in the True Martial Realm.
After the mine was safe, Chen Xiang said goodbye to Dan Yuan and returned to Taiwuzong!
While Chen Xiang was flying, he was also thinking about how to deal with Elder Tan's collusion with the Lu family and the Demonic Sect; he must get rid of this dangerous person!
Six days have passed and Chen Xiang is flying in the clouds in Taoyuan Province. He felt extremely bored because he couldn't see the beautiful scenery below. Just when he was about to fly lower, a powerful Qi suddenly rose into the sky and lifted up a large amount of clouds; this surprised him. Looking carefully, he heard the sound of fighting, but he didn't expect that someone was fighting below.
Chen Xiang hid above the clouds and flew to a remote place. He landed on a high mountain and observed the battle, but saw many men in black robes besieging a group of men in white robes.
"Aren't they disciples of Danxiang Daoyuan? Are those men in black robes demonic warriors? "
Chen Xiang said uncertainly. He slid down from the top of the mountain and took out a sword.
Those men in black robes were holding strange weapons, and their true energy was also very strange and evil. After getting closer, Chen Xiang was sure that they were demonic warriors. They attacked not only the disciples of Danxiang Taoyuan, but also the disciples of Zhenwu Sect and Beast Martial Sect.
The relationship between Taiwuzong and Danxiang Taoyuan has always been very good. They never had any conflict. Obviously, Chen Xiang wanted to save them because their current situation was very unfavorable. There are many demon warriors around them, and those demon warriors are stronger than them.
"There are actually two warriors at the third level of the True Martial Realm. It seems that the demon disciples are really desperate! "
Chen Xiang took out the Azure Dragon Demon Slaying Knife. If he didn't use this magic sword, he wouldn't be able to solve this matter easily. In addition, he also has to be wary of the disciples of the Zhenwu Sect and the Beast Martial Sect.
When he poured Qinglong Qi into the Qinglong Demon-Slaying Knife, a suffocating breath suddenlyFlow out. Chen Xiang brandished this domineering sword and rushed into the crowd. He slashed down with the sword, drawing a bright blue arc and making a 'xiu xiu' sound. This blow instantly killed ten warriors at the tenth level of the Mortal Martial Realm.
Chen Xiang immediately released the Qi screen; this was the [Xuanwu Luo Tianshi]. In this way, he can have a very strong defense. Coupled with this invisible aura, people with insufficient strength cannot approach him; they will feel as if they have been hit by a powerful wave.
When the disciples of Danxiang Taoyuan saw someone coming to help, they immediately found that the weapons used by the savior were somewhat familiar. They found out that this was the treasure weapon used by Chen Xiang that they had heard about, and then they felt relieved. As soon as Chen Xiang arrived, he quickly and cleanly killed dozens of warriors at the tenth level of the Mortal Martial Realm.
Chen Xiang's killing heart began to beat, absorbing a large amount of evil energy, and at the same time, he continuously released strong killing energy, frightening the demon warriors, as if they had encountered the incarnation of the devil.
Chen Xiang's sword was like a thunderbolt that danced wildly, killing those demonic warriors and blasting them to pieces. In the blink of an eye, there were only two third-level demon warriors in the True Martial Realm left.
"Chen Xiang, our Bone Transformation Clan will not let you go!"
A one-eyed man said while slapping the tall and thin young man next to him. The palm fell on the thin body with terrifying power, causing the tall and thin young man to fly towards Chen Xiang. While letting out a grievance scream, his body turned into poisonous black water and splashed towards Chen Xiang.
Chen Xiang just dodged sideways and dodged. He didn't expect that the demonic warrior would be so vicious, sacrificing his companions to escape.
The one-eyed man thought he could delay Chen Xiang for a while so that he could escape quickly. However, before he could run very far, he suddenly felt a suffocating pressure swallowing his body from behind.
Chen Xiang chased the one-eyed man while waving the Azure Dragon Demon-Slaying Knife. The fierce blade slashed down, an explosion broke out, and the one-eyed man was cut into pieces.
The disciples of Danxiang Taoyuan, Zhenwu Sect, and Beast Martial Sect couldn't help but shudder when they saw this scene. Just now, they were locked in a bitter battle; if this continues, they will definitely be annihilated. However, they did not expect that Chen Xiang would appear and kill the disciples of the Huagu Clan all by himself.
"Is this the strength of the youngest and strongest warrior in the history of Taiwu Sect? Worth ten million crystals, Chen Xiang!"
A Danxiang Taoyuan disciple exclaimed.
"It does look very similar! Although it looks very different, the big knife is exactly the same as the one I saw on the wanted poster!"
Another man said.
Just when the disciples of Danxiang Taoyuan were filled with gratitude, the disciples of Zhenwu Sect and Beast Martial Sect swarmed in like bees, with weapons in their hands and greedy expressions on their faces; they believed that with so many people, they would be able to catch Chen Xiang, and by then, they would be able to get the 10 million spar and sword in Chen Xiang's hand.
"Ungrateful guys, stop them!"
shouted a middle-aged man from Danxiang Taoyuan. He flew over with a spear in hand and stabbed to death the Zhenwu Sect disciple who rushed towards Chen Xiang without hesitation.
After seeing the master's skillful performance, the disciples of Danxiang Taoyuan also rushed up one by one and started fighting with the disciples of Zhenwu Sect and Beast Martial Sect.
"Junior Brother Danxiang Taoyuan, Junior Brother, come behind me!"
Chen Xiang shouted loudly; the expression on his face was completely solemn and cold. He had just saved the disciples of the Zhenwu Sect and the Beast Martial Sect. Not only were they ungrateful, they also dared to attack him!
